searchText: thanks Ryan, that's useful! so an already-synced archive node generates negligible IOPS. during the initial sync though I guess it's much higher. do you think SATA speeds are realistic in syncing an archive node from scratch? Depends on what kind of time frame you're willing to wait, definitely the more IOPS the better but both are going to be somewhat slow-going.
